Dear Mahira,

I'm excited to apply for the Content & Community Marketeer role at Curafyt. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in content creation, SEO, and social media, I'm drawn to Curafyt's mission of combining science and transparency to improve animal wellbeing.

At Episto, I've developed and executed content strategies that boosted organic visibility for clients. On my own project, mirook.com, I built a WordPress site from scratch, created engaging content, and integrated social media—skills directly applicable to managing Curafyt's social channels and community.

I'm particularly excited about the opportunity to create short-form video content and build influencer partnerships. I'm a quick learner, comfortable with analytics, and passionate about using digital channels to drive growth.

I'd love to discuss how I can contribute to Curafyt's expansion in the Netherlands and beyond. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Mahira,

When I read about Curafyt's mission to combine science, transparency, and sustainability in animal health, I knew I had to apply. As a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation and a passion for content, I'm excited about the opportunity to help grow Curafyt's brand and community across the Netherlands and beyond.

In my current role at Episto, I've honed my skills in content creation and SEO. I write keyword-targeted blog posts that drive organic traffic, and I manage WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra. I'm comfortable with analytics tools like Google Analytics and Search Console, which I use to refine content strategies. This experience has taught me how to create content that resonates with audiences and performs well in search.

On my own project, mirook.com, I've taken a hands-on approach to building an online presence. I designed and built the site, implemented structured data for better visibility in AI-powered search, and integrated social media to engage with the community. This project has given me practical experience in content calendars, social media coordination, and community engagement—skills directly relevant to this role.

I'm particularly drawn to the creative aspects of this position: developing short-form videos, testing new formats, and building long-term relationships with influencers and UGC creators. I'm a quick learner, eager to dive into new tools and trends, and I thrive in fast-paced environments.

Curafyt's scale-up culture and the chance to own my work are exactly what I'm looking for. I'm excited about the possibility of contributing to a brand that genuinely improves the lives of horses and dogs.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can help Curafyt scale.

Best regards,

Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
